reason: A Windows GUI and CLI media tool for generating foreground mattes from images, videos, and frame directories with batch and interactive processing.

summaries.zh: 通过图形界面或命令行从图片、视频和帧目录生成前景透明度遮罩，并输出合成与透明图像。
summaries.en: A GUI and command-line tool that creates foreground alpha mattes from images, videos, and frame directories with batch and interactive processing.

capabilities: Reads image, video, and frame-directory inputs
Generates alpha mattes, composites, and transparent RGBA outputs
Supports GUI and command-line batch processing
Downloads model checkpoints and runtime dependencies from Hugging Face
Provides interactive matting using point, box, mask, or text prompts
